ينتهجا (form VII)
# يَنْتَهِجَا (yantahijā) /jan.ta.hi.d͡ʒaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# يُنْتَهَجَا (yuntahajā) /jun.ta.ha.d͡ʒaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
